name: Jameica
blurb: Jameica is an Application-Platform written in Java containing a SWT-UI.
description:
Jameica is an Application-Platform written in Java containing a SWT-UI. It provides different services
(GUI-Toolkit, Logging, Security, Backup, Lifecycle-Management, Message-Bus) to the installed plugins.
It's a kind of runtime environment similar to OSGi.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
